title: His mother wanted him to be a concert singer
summary: He says he had not danced yet; his mother was strict about his becoming a singer like Robeson or Caruso, but that did not happen.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: So you never did any dancing for them? You hadn't danced as of yet?
No, I didn't dance as of yet, no. That came after. When I first danced was with Tiger Flowers.
But your mother always had ambitions for you as a --

Right, uh-huh, very, very strict about that. You know, she thought it was something in my voice, I could sing, you know, and was going to grow up to be a big concert singer like Paul Robeson or someone, you know, Enrico Caruso, you know, famous voices, you know.
And evidently that didn't happen, because further on up the road --
